cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.
